about_the_game:
Features

  • Auto-firing weapons that let you focus on movement and strategy

  • Expandable, grid-based inventory system for creative item layouts

  • Jewels that can be engraved onto inventory cells for unique bonuses

  • Deep shop system with hundreds of items to discover and combine

  • Large cast of playable Rogueggs, each with unique stats and playstyles

  • Choose map modifiers to increase challenge and rewards

  • Fast-paced waves lasting 25–60 seconds for quick, intense runs

This demo is a vertical slice of the full game, which means you can experience what the game has to offer in 11 waves. The full game is expected to ship with 100 waves and a final "endless" wave at the end. Additionally the demo contains 30 playable characters, which is planned to expand up to 60 on full release. The amount of playable weapons in the demo is 19 and the full game is planned with up to 80 different weapons. The amount of items that are available in the shop is above 100 and in the full game this is planned to be expanded to around 200-250.

name: Roguegg: Hardboiled Survivors Demo

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS *: Windows 7 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-2100 or AMD FX-4100
  • Memory: 2048 MB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD Graphics 4000 or equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Integrated sound card
  • VR Support: Not supported

short_description: Roguegg: Hardboiled Survivors is a top-down roguelike bullet heaven where you play as a brave egg fighting hordes of bugs. Collect upgrades, manage your grid inventory, and craft unique builds to survive the swarm before they scramble you!
supported_languages: English, French, German, Spanish - Spain, Japanese, Korean, Polish, Portuguese - Brazil, Portuguese - Portugal, Russian, Simplified Chinese, Spanish - Latin America, Turkish
